_comment: Online Mission Room (spec: Online room). The relay the phones and the host screen talk through (Supabase Realtime broadcast and presence on public channels; only the project's public publishable key is in the site), and the room's rules: seats, holds, expiry, rate limits, codes. Every number is a game rule, not NASA data. An empty publishableKey means the relay is not set up: the room says OFFLINE and offers local co-op.

relay.source: Supabase Realtime, free plan (checked Nov 2026: 200 concurrent connections, 100 messages/s, 2 million messages a month, 256 KB payloads)

protocol.source: Game rule (Online room): a phone and a host must speak the same protocol version, or the phone is asked to reload

maxSeats.source: Game rule (Online room): one phone per role, four roles

seatHold_s.source: Game rule (Online room, mockup T7c): a dropped phone's role is held, and the clock paused, this long before the role passes to the Flight Director

hostGrace_s.source: Game rule (Online room): the phones wait this long for a host screen that dropped (a reload) before the room ends with its resume code

roomTtl_h.source: Game rule (Online room): a room closes this long after it opened (a lesson and a half); its resume code still works

idleClose_min.source: Game rule (Online room): a room with no phone linked and nothing sent for this long closes

resumeTtl_days.source: Game rule (Online room): a resume code is kept in the host's browser this long

connectTimeout_s.source: Game rule (Online room): a relay that has not answered in this long is offline (the room offers local co-op)

retryEvery_s.source: Game rule (Online room, mockup T7a/T7e): an offline relay is tried again this often

clockResync_s.source: Game rule (Online room): the host screen repeats its flight clock this often (and at every play, pause, hold and speed change); phones run the clock in between, which keeps a room near one message per phone every ten seconds

clockDrift_days.source: Game rule (Online room): the host shares its clock again whenever it has drifted this far from what the phones are running on (an order in transit runs the clock faster)

rate_perS.source: Game rule (Online room): each phone's steady action rate (a token bucket); faster taps are refused with SLOW DOWN

burst.source: Game rule (Online room): how many quick taps a phone may make at once before the steady rate applies

codeWords.source: Game rule (Online room, mockup T6a): a room code is a space word and three characters, e.g. MARS-7K2

codeAlphabet.source: Game rule (Online room): the code's characters leave out 0, O, 1, I and L, which children mix up when they type
